social.author: @jcrabapple@dmv.community
social.text: 🎹 The M-VAVE FM-1 might be the most hacked piece of synth hardware out right now. It's a cheap little FM synth with a full color screen, USB MIDI and audio, battery power, and an output jack, for under $100. M-VAVE never shipped an SDK, so people reverse engineered the thing and built their own, and the firmware scene has exploded: 45 firmwares two weeks ago, 154 today. Some of what you can install: BauGirl's firmware, which fixes the original engine's bugs, adds an entirely new synthesis engine and a UI nicer than most commercial synths. Groove OS, which turns it into a full groovebox. Feluca, the open source firmware that added Mutable Instruments style physical modeling and opened the floodgates. Grim for haunted dungeon synth. AM1, a generative ambient machine inspired by Eno's Music for Airports. Coral Flower, loosely inspired by the Telepathic Instruments Orchid. Obervave for late 70s Oberheim sounds. And dozens more in every direction. MVAVE took it well and released their own open source SDK and a community-modifiable firmware. Behringer and Akai have both announced competing open source hardware projects, and an FM2 is teased. Firmwares: https:// thefirmwarehub.com Video: https:// youtu.be/hmYPh5CYtWw # synthesizer # musicproduction # fm1

social.text: Chekhov’s gun 🎬 A storytelling principle from 19th-century Russian playwright Anton Chekhov: every prominent element in a story should be necessary. Often paraphrased as “if a gun appears in Act One, it should go off by Act Three.” In film it’s called “plant and payoff.” If a detail gets screen time, it should matter later. If it never does, cut it. # Filmmaking # Screenwriting # ChekhovsGun # Storytelling # FilmTechnique
